missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Тайна' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Страшная' and 'семейная' are agreeing feminine adjectives describing the secret.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Тайну' is the accusative direct object of 'хранит'. 'Её' is the possessive showing whose secret it is.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Тайны' is genitive after 'у' to show whose mystery it is. 'Нет разгадки' uses the genitive of negation.
Strategic focus: Accusative with dative. 'Тайну' is the accusative object of 'доверила', while 'подруге' is the dative recipient who was told.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'Тайне' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic of the conversation. 'Шёпотом' is the instrumental adverb.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Тайной' is the instrumental expressing what covered the letter. 'Письмо' is the neuter nominative subject.

missions.phrase: К этой тайне привело старое письмо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Тайне' takes the dative after 'к' to mean leading to the secret. 'Старое письмо' is the neuter nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantifier. 'Тайн' is the genitive plural after 'много', formed with a zero ending. 'В этом доме' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Тайны' is nominative plural as the subject of 'раскрылись'. 'Все' quantifies them, and 'наконец' adds resolution.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Тайны' takes the genitive under the negated verb 'не знает'. 'Никто' is the negative subject agreeing with the double negation.
